prepNotes.text: Lucy Campbell won the women's worldwide 2026 CrossFit Open with 16 points, finishing 2nd in 26.1, 4th in 26.2 and 10th in 26.3 to beat 2025 Open winner Mirjam von Rohr, who finished 2nd with 18 points. It was an epic battle between the two, with von Rohr beating Campbell only in 26.1.
prepNotes.sourceTitle: 2026 CrossFit Open Results - Colten Mertens and Lucy Campbell Win (Fitness Volt)

prepNotes.text: Campbell qualified for the 2025 CrossFit Games by winning the Wodland Fest in-person qualifier in Malaga, Spain with 606 points, 58 points ahead of the second qualifier (South Korea's Seung Yeon Choi). The result capped a comeback from Kienbock's disease in her wrist; after finishing 16th at her first Games in 2022 she experienced wrist pain, underwent a second surgical procedure in summer 2024, and returned to competition in October 2024 (winning the Marbella Championships in Spain).
prepNotes.sourceTitle: Lucy Campbell Qualifies for 2025 CrossFit Games, Continuing Incredible Career Comeback (BarBend)

prepNotes.text: Campbell finished 2nd overall (runner-up) in the women's division at the 2025 CrossFit Games, and was selected to be among the first to attempt 26.2 at the live Open workout announcement on Thursday, March 5, 2026, alongside Aimee Cringle and Mirjam von Rohr, broadcast live from CrossFit Black Edition in Lisbon, Portugal.

prepNotes.text: Madeline (Maddie) Sturt won the women's division of the 2026 TYR Torian Pro, the Oceania CrossFit Games Semifinal held May 22-24 at Pat Rafter Arena in Brisbane, finishing first with 607 points ahead of Ellie Turner (601) and Kyra Milligan (586). As a top-three finisher she qualified for the 2026 CrossFit Games.
prepNotes.sourceTitle: 2026 Torian Pro Results - The Barbell Spin

prepNotes.text: Sturt placed 6th in the women's division at the 2025 CrossFit Games, improving on her 8th-place finish in 2024; her CrossFit Games athlete profile lists her affiliate as Reebok CrossFit Frankston (Australia).
prepNotes.sourceTitle: Athlete: Madeline Sturt | CrossFit Games

prepNotes.text: Sturt was featured (as a six-time Games qualifier) alongside fellow Australians Ricky Garard and Jay Crouch in CrossFit's official 'Road to the Games' series (episode 25.05) ahead of the 2025 CrossFit Games (Aug. 1-3, Albany, New York), reflecting on years of perseverance: 'I feel like I've literally been doing CrossFit forever ... I'm proud of myself to be able to keep fighting, keep pushing.'
prepNotes.sourceTitle: CrossFit | Road to the Games 25.05: Garard / Crouch / Sturt
